title: Fast Katanas
description: Katanas that fit into vanilla gameplay.
body:
**📖What is this mod about?**

_This mod adds **katanas** that are as close to **vanilla** as possible, made from each material. **In the future**, I might come up with something **new** to spice things up 🎉._

🎮**What's the use of them?**

1. This is the best weapon for mobile close combat.⚔️
2. They will help to diversify the gaming process.🔎
3. And they just look cool.💎



_I might release a version for Forge and newer versions._
